display.description: Balance from level 1 to 60, and the default for any Forever Druid no other premade fits (levels 1–9, untalented casters, solo Restoration). Pulls with Wrath; while moving, refreshes Moonfire, Insect Swarm and, in a group, Faerie Fire. Hurricane when three or more enemies are fighting you, then your own Moonfire and Insect Swarm on a target that is not nearly dead, Starfire while Eclipse charges or Clearcasting are up, and Wrath. Regrowth on yourself below half health while solo; out of mana it lets you melee. Reminders: Mark of the Wild, Thorns while solo, Moonkin Form, a pre-pull Rejuvenation while solo, Nature's Grasp when a mob is on you, Innervate. Form changes, crowd control, Barkskin and target choice stay with you. Built from level-30 beta guides; level 31–60 steps follow the class design and are untested.
display.name: Druid: Balance (Forever)

display.description: Warcraft Tavern's Multi-DoT leveling style, an alternative to the Balance premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Pulls with Wrath, keeps your Moonfire and Insect Swarm on the target, roots it with Entangling Roots once both are running while another enemy is fighting you, then Wrath. No Starfire (the build skips Eclipse). Switching to the next enemy is up to you. Reminders: Mark of the Wild, Thorns while solo.
display.name: Druid: Balance, Multi-DoT (Forever, Warcraft Tavern)

display.description: Cat and Bear in one premade, chosen by your form; it takes over once you know a Feral talent spell or shift into Cat or Bear Form. Cat: Ravage or Shred from Prowl, Faerie Fire, Shifting Power below 60 energy, Rip at four combo points on a target that will live, Ferocious Bite once Rip runs, Rake, then Shred when the target is not facing you (Claw otherwise). Bear: Faerie Fire and Feral Charge at range, Demoralizing Roar in a group or on two enemies, Primal Bite, Swipe on three or more, Lacerate, Swipe. In caster form it suggests Cat Form (Bear before you have Cat) and Regrowth when hurt out of combat. Reminders: Maul with spare rage, Enrage, Berserk on big pulls or elites, Frenzied Regeneration, Innervate, Mark of the Wild, Thorns. Taunts, interrupts and positioning stay with you.
display.name: Druid: Feral, Cat and Bear (Forever)

display.description: Group healing after Warcraft Tavern, from your first Restoration talent spell (Swiftmend or Wild Growth). Heals your current friendly target: Swiftmend on a hurt target with your HoT, Wild Growth when three or more allies are hurt, Regrowth, Rejuvenation on your focus or anyone hurt, Healing Touch on a badly hurt target. On a hostile target: Moonfire, Insect Swarm, Wrath. Reminders: Innervate below 30% mana, Nature's Swiftness on a dying target, Tranquility, Remove Curse and Abolish Poison, Mark of the Wild. You pick who to heal and the spell rank; solo Restoration uses the Balance premade.
display.name: Druid: Restoration (Forever)

display.description: Icy Veins' HoT-first healing, an alternative to the Restoration premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Rejuvenation on your focus and anyone hurt, Regrowth for stronger heals, Healing Touch only with both HoTs running, Swiftmend when a HoT target drops low, then Wild Growth. Innervate on cooldown. Otherwise the same reminders and hostile-target list as the Restoration premade.
display.name: Druid: Restoration, HoTs first (Forever, Icy Veins)

display.description: Every ranged Hunter from level 1 to 60 (Beast Mastery, Marksmanship, and Survival until Strider Kick), and the Forever Hunter default. Pull: Hunter's Mark, Sniper Shot while Rapid Killing lasts, Auto Shot. Then your own Serpent Sting, Summon Hawk twice and Arcane Shot once on their shared cooldown (Arcane Shot on cooldown before Summon Hawk), Sniper Shot under Rapid Killing or on elites, Aimed Shot. Two or more enemies fighting you: Multi-Shot instead of Aimed Shot, Explosive Trap with three near you, Volley on five. Moving: instant shots only. A mob in melee range gets Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite. Reminders: Aspect of the Hawk (Monkey before it), Trueshot Aura, pet calling, reviving and Mend Pet, Rapid Fire, Bestial Wrath and Blood Fury on elites or in dungeons, Intimidation when a mob is on you. Pet commands, feeding, kiting and Feign Death stay with you; disable the pet reminders if you play Lone Wolf. It never reads your mana, which Forever is reported to hide in combat.
display.name: Hunter: ranged (Forever, Wowhead)

display.description: Mobalytics' mana-saving leveling style, an alternative to the Wowhead ranged premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Keeps your Serpent Sting up, one Summon Hawk out, Aimed Shot (Multi-Shot on two or more enemies), a second Hawk only on a healthy target, and never Arcane Shot once Summon Hawk is known. Same pull, melee, movement and reminders as the Wowhead premade.
display.name: Hunter: ranged, mana-saving (Forever, Mobalytics)

display.description: Dual-wield melee Survival once you know Strider Kick (until then the ranged premade levels you, as the guides advise). Pull with Hunter's Mark and Serpent Sting, then Mongoose Bite, Strider Kick, Raptor Strike and Counterattack, with Explosive Trap on three or more enemies. Out of melee it shoots: Serpent Sting, Arcane Shot, Aimed Shot, Auto Shot. Reminders: Aspect of the Beast, Hunter's Mark (Expose Prey needs it), Rapid Fire and Blood Fury on elites or in dungeons, Deterrence, pet care. An optional Immolation Trap step is off by default.
display.name: Hunter: Survival melee (Forever, Wowhead)

display.description: Wowhead's in-and-out weave for a two-handed Survival Hunter, an alternative to the Survival melee premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. In melee: Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike; when Raptor Strike is more than 2.5 seconds away, Strider Kick and step out. Out of melee: Serpent Sting, Arcane Shot, Aimed Shot and Auto Shot until Raptor Strike is nearly ready, then back in. You do the moving; RM follows your range.
display.name: Hunter: Survival two-hand weave (Forever, Wowhead)

display.description: Arcane once you know Arcane Blast and not Ice Lance. Pulls with Frostbolt solo or Arcane Blast in a group; then Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage, Arcane Blast on Clearcasting, Arcane Wrath at three Arcane Blast stacks, Arcane Blast up to four stacks on elites and two on other targets while you have over 35% mana, then Frostfire Bolt, Frostbolt or Fireball to fish for Missile Barrage, and a wand when nearly out of mana solo. Without Arcane Wrath (the older beta design) Fire Blast spends the stacks. Moving: Fire Blast. Three or more enemies fighting you: Arcane Explosion. Reminders: Presence of Mind and Arcane Power on elites, plus the Mage upkeep reminders.
display.name: Mage: Arcane (Forever)

display.description: Fire once you know Pyroblast. Pulls with Pyroblast on elites, else Frostfire Bolt or Fireball; then Pyroblast at three Heating Up stacks, Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost or a frozen target (Fire/Frost hybrids), Fire Blast on cooldown, Scorch to keep your five Fire Vulnerability stacks on elites, Frostfire Bolt (from 40) or Fireball, wand when nearly out of mana solo. Moving: Fire Blast or Ice Lance. Four or more enemies fighting you: Flamestrike, Blast Wave, Arcane Explosion. RM cannot see Improved Scorch, so the step that starts Scorch stacks (and a close-range Scorch) is off until you enable it. Reminders: Combustion and Presence of Mind on elites, plus the Mage upkeep reminders.
display.name: Mage: Fire (Forever)

display.description: Icy Veins' Fire leveling build without Improved Scorch, an alternative to the Fire premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Pulls with Pyroblast, uses Fire Blast to finish low targets and to spend Wake of Fire, Scorch as the mob closes or dies, then Frostfire Bolt (from 40) or Fireball. Same AoE, movement, wand and reminders as the Fire premade, without Combustion and Presence of Mind.
display.name: Mage: Fire leveling (Forever, Icy Veins)

display.description: Frost from level 1 to 60, and the Forever Mage default before talent spells (Fireball until Frostbolt at level 4). Pulls with Frostbolt; then Ice Lance on Fingers of Frost or a frozen target (also while Frostbolt is still casting, to cancel or batch), Cone of Cold at five Winter's Chill stacks, Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage, Fire Blast to finish, Frostbolt, and a wand when solo and nearly out of mana. Moving: Ice Lance, else Fire Blast. Three or more enemies fighting you: Cone of Cold; five or more: Blizzard, or Arcane Explosion with a mob on you. Warcraft Tavern's Flamestrike and Arcane Explosion AoE is included but off. Reminders: Arcane Intellect, armor (Ice or Frost solo, Mage Armor in a group, never replacing one you chose), Ice Barrier, Evocation, Counterspell, Remove Lesser Curse, Frost Nova when a mob reaches you, Cold Snap, Ice Block. Blink, kiting, Polymorph and mana gems stay with you.
display.name: Mage: Frost (Forever)

display.description: Group healing once you know Holy Shock, while Righteous Fury is off (a grouped Shockadin lands here too). Heals your current friendly target: Holy Shock in an emergency or while moving, Holy Shock on a target with your Light's Vigil and Light's Vigil when three or more allies are hurt, Cleanse or Purify, Holy Light (faster with Infusion of Light) for big deficits, Flash of Light as the main heal. On an enemy: Judgement of Light when Seal of Light is up, Holy Shock and Light's Vigil with mana to spare, Holy Strike, Exorcism. Reminders: Seal of Light when you have no seal, Divine Favor, Lay on Hands on a dying target, your aura and Blessing. You pick who to heal.
display.name: Paladin: Holy (Forever)

display.description: Wowhead's healing style, an alternative to the Holy premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Holy Shock as a routine heal on cooldown, dispels, Holy Light for big deficits, Flash of Light. On an enemy it keeps your Judgement of Light up by swapping to Seal of Light, judging and swapping back to Seal of Righteousness, then Holy Strike, Exorcism on Undead and Demons, Holy Shock and Consecration. Same reminders as the Holy premade.
display.name: Paladin: Holy, Holy Shock on cooldown (Forever, Wowhead)

display.description: Tanking, once you know Swift Judgement or Templar's Bulwark or turn on Righteous Fury. When the target is fighting someone else: Judgement with Seal of Fury (the taunt), Swift Judgement to reset it. Two or more enemies engaged: Consecration, Exorcism and Holy Wrath on Undead and Demons, Holy Strike. One enemy: Exorcism on Undead and Demons, Holy Strike, Consecration with mana to spare. Reminders: Righteous Fury, Seal of Fury, Judgement on cooldown, Templar's Bulwark when low, Holy Shield while tanking, Lay on Hands, your aura and Blessing. Pulling, positioning and other taunts stay with you.
display.name: Paladin: Protection (Forever, Wowhead)

display.description: Icy Veins' tanking style, an alternative to the Wowhead Protection premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Consecration first whenever you have mana, on one enemy too; Judgement is kept for taunts (no on-cooldown reminder), with Swift Judgement to reset it; then Holy Strike and Exorcism on Undead and Demons. Same tank reminders otherwise.
display.name: Paladin: Protection, Consecration first (Forever, Icy Veins)

display.description: Retribution and every melee Paladin from level 1 to 60, and the Forever Paladin default. Keeps a damage seal up, refreshed only when it runs low: Seal of the Crusader judged once on a healthy or elite target, then Seal of Command with a slow (3.0 s) weapon, else Seal of Righteousness. Then Holy Strike on cooldown, Holy Shock and Light's Vigil for a Shockadin, Exorcism on Undead and Demons, Consecration on three or more enemies or with mana to spare, Hammer of Wrath with mana to spare, and melee. Judgement is off the global cooldown, so it is a reminder whenever a seal is up and you have mana. Other reminders: your aura and Blessing (Retribution Aura and Kings once learned; yours are kept), healing when hurt out of combat, Lay on Hands. Optional steps, off by default: Hammer of Justice before a Seal of Command Judgement, and Twist of Light seal swapping for a 31-point Retribution build. Built from level-30 beta guides.
display.name: Paladin: Retribution (Forever)

display.description: Shadow, and every Priest's solo play, from level 1 to 60; the Forever Priest default. Pulls with Power Word: Shield (solo) and Mind Blast (Holy Fire for Holy and Discipline, Smite before Mind Blast). Then Shadowform once learned, your own Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague, Mind Blast while the target is healthy (always in Shadowform or a group), Shadow Word: Death to execute, Holy Fire into Penance for Discipline, Mind Flay in Shadowform; solo before Shadowform, Holy Nova on three enemies with Holy Purpose, Mind Flay with mana to spare, then the wand (Smite without one). Moving: Pain, Plague, Death. Below 35% health while solo: Shield, Desperate Prayer and a heal (not in Shadowform). Reminders: Inner Fire, Fortitude, Divine Spirit, racial buffs, Vampiric Embrace, Inner Focus, Silence, Dark Sacrifice, Elune's Light; Psychic Scream is off by default. Built from level-30 beta guides; Shadowform play follows Mobalytics.
display.name: Priest: Shadow and solo damage (Forever)

display.description: Mobalytics' leveling style, an alternative to the Shadow premade: enable it and disable that one, or raise its priority. Mind Blast and Holy Fire only on tough mobs (elites, or two levels above you), your own Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague on a target that will live, then the wand (Smite without one). From Shadowform: Mind Blast, Pain, Plague, Mind Flay. Shield and Renew on yourself between pulls with mana to spare, Cure Disease on yourself. Below 35% health while solo: Shield, Renew, a heal. Spreading Pain across several mobs is up to you.
display.name: Priest: DoT and wand leveling (Forever, Mobalytics)

display.description: Group healing once you know a healing talent spell (Holy Nova, Binding Heal, Penance or Prayer of Mending) and not Shadowform. Heals your current friendly target: before the pull Power Word: Shield, Prayer of Mending and Renew; below 35% Shield, Penance and Flash Heal; Dispel Magic and Abolish or Cure Disease; Prayer of Mending; Prayer of Healing (and Holy Nova on Holy Purpose) when three allies are hurt; Binding Heal when you are both hurt; Penance; Renew; Greater Heal, Heal or Lesser Heal. On an enemy: Shadow Word: Pain, Holy Fire, Penance, Smite, wand. Reminders: Inner Fire, Fortitude, Divine Spirit, Power Infusion on another player, Inner Focus, Desperate Prayer and the racial spells. You pick who to heal and the rank; a Discipline healer before Penance (20–29) selects it by hand.
display.name: Priest: Discipline and Holy healing (Forever)

display.description: Melee damage for every Rogue specialization from level 1 to 60, built from Icy Veins, Wowhead and Warcraft Tavern. The builder follows what you know: Mutilate (Sinister Strike for the fifth point), Hemorrhage, Backstab when the target is not facing you, else Sinister Strike. From Stealth it opens with Premeditation, Cheap Shot when solo, Garrote for Subtlety on group elites, else Ambush or Garrote. It keeps Slice and Dice and Venom up, uses Expose Armor in groups on elites when no warrior has five Sunders, then spends five points on Rupture (Subtlety, long fights) or Eviscerate, and never builds past five. Reminders: poisons on each weapon, Kick, Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush on packs and elites, Cold Blood, Evasion, Feint, Thistle Tea and Preparation. Left to you: Vanish, Sprint, Kidney Shot, Blind, Sap and positioning. Forever restricts combat data, so Rotation Master lists this premade for reference and does not select it automatically yet.
display.name: Forever Rogue: melee DPS

display.description: Warcraft Tavern's Ambush/Cutthroat Subtlety build: Premeditation and Ambush on every opener, Ambush again whenever Cutthroat allows it, Backstab from behind as the builder (Hemorrhage when the target is facing you), Ghostly Strike on cooldown, and Slice and Dice then Eviscerate at five points with no Rupture. Reminds you to Vanish for another Ambush on a tanked boss. Choose it instead of the recommended Rogue premade if you took the Cutthroat talents; Rotation Master cannot see passive talents to tell. Same poison and cooldown reminders as the recommended premade. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Rogue: Subtlety, Ambush build (Warcraft Tavern)

display.description: Wowhead's Subtlety: Premeditation and Garrote on every opener, and Vanish (then Preparation) used in the rotation to open with Garrote again once the last one has run out. Slice and Dice kept up, Expose Armor in groups, Rupture as the five-point finisher, Hemorrhage as the only builder. This spends Vanish, your escape, on damage: choose it deliberately. Same poison and cooldown reminders as the recommended premade. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Rogue: Subtlety, Garrote build (Wowhead)

display.description: Ranged Elemental once you know Lava Burst, after Icy Veins (before Lava Burst the Enhancement premade plays the melee hybrid every guide recommends). Pulls with Lightning Bolt (Chain Lightning on a pack), casts only instants while moving, uses Fire Nova and Chain Lightning on three or more enemies, keeps Flame Shock on targets that will live, Lava Burst on cooldown, Stormstrike and Earth Shock if you know Stormstrike, Fire Nova on Clearcasting in groups, then Lightning Bolt. Below 30% mana in melee it lets auto-attack refill mana. Reminders: shield, weapon imbue, Searing or Magma Totem, group totems, Elemental Mastery, interrupt and heals when solo. Left to you: Earthbind kiting, Frost Shock, Purge and other totems. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Shaman: Elemental

display.description: Melee Enhancement from level 1 to 60, and the default for any Shaman before Lava Burst or Mana Tide Totem. Pulls with Lightning Bolt from range, then Stormstrike on cooldown, an instant Lightning Bolt at five Maelstrom Weapon stacks, Fire Nova (with a Fire totem down) and Flame Shock on three or more enemies, Earth Shock into the Stormstrike debuff, Flame Shock in groups on targets that will live, and Earth Shock on cooldown. Below 40% mana with Stormstrike it stops casting and lets auto-attack refill mana; Lightning Bolt fills the gap while the target is out of reach. Reminders: weapon imbue (Windfury, else Flametongue, else Rockbiter), Water or Lightning Shield, the Earth Shock interrupt, Searing or Magma Totem, group totems, Rage of the Farseer, Stoneclaw Totem and solo heals. Left to you: totem presets, Frost Shock, Purge and other totems. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Shaman: Enhancement (Icy Veins)

display.description: Wowhead's and Mobalytics' mana-saving Enhancement: auto-attack does the work, Stormstrike only while Improved Stormstrike's mana regeneration is down, no Earth Shock in the rotation (shocks pull and interrupt), and in groups or on packs Searing Totem with Fire Nova on cooldown. Same imbue, shield and interrupt reminders as the Icy Veins premade. Choose it instead of that premade if mana runs out. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Shaman: Enhancement, mana-efficient (Wowhead)

display.description: Healing once you know Mana Tide Totem, after Icy Veins. With a friendly target: Nature's Swiftness and an instant Healing Wave when the target drops below 30%, Cure Poison and Cure Disease, Riptide on a hurt target without it, Chain Heal when three nearby group members are hurt, Lesser Healing Wave below 40%, Healing Wave below 90%. You pick who to heal by targeting them. With a hostile target and nothing to heal: Fire Nova and Chain Lightning on packs, Stormstrike and Earth Shock if you know Stormstrike, Flame Shock on targets that will live, Lightning Bolt, then melee. Reminders: Water Shield, the Earth Shock interrupt, Mana Tide and group buff totems. Left to you: downranking, other totems, Purge and Ghost Wolf. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Shaman: Restoration

display.description: Every Warlock talent tree from level 1 to 60, merged from Icy Veins, Wowhead and Method; the steps for a tree appear once you know its talent spells. Pulls with Immolate and Bane of Agony (Destruction precasts Shadow Bolt), uses Nightfall and Decimation procs, keeps Demonic Brand up with Searing Pain, and below 20% target health stops adding DoTs (Drain Soul for shards, Shadowburn, Conflagrate, or the wand). While moving it casts only instants. On packs: Hellfire in a group, Rain of Fire, Corruption and Agony. Then Bane of Doom on elites and bosses or Bane of Agony, Curse of the Elements in groups and on elites, Immolate, Corruption, Siphon Life on targets that will live, Conflagrate and Shadowburn; solo it Life Taps, drains when hurt and fills with Wrack, Drain Life or the wand; otherwise Incinerate or Shadow Bolt. Reminders: armor, a demon (Succubus, else Voidwalker, else Imp), Fel Domination, Demonic Sacrifice with Demonic Pact, Soul Link, Health Funnel, weapon stones, Amplify Curse and Bane of Havoc for a second enemy. Left to you: sending the pet in, other curses, Fear, Healthstones and other targets. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warlock: all trees

display.description: Icy Veins' Warlock leveling: the wand is the solo filler (Drain Life only when hurt), Voidwalker is the default demon, Affliction and Destruction sacrifice their demon and play without one (from 41 and 55), Demonology keeps Demonic Brand up and uses Immolate only as a filler, Agony and Corruption go only on targets that will live, and Destruction puts Bane of Havoc on the durable enemy of a pack and Conflagrates on cooldown once Incinerate is known. Choose it instead of the recommended Warlock premade if you follow Icy Veins. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warlock: all trees (Icy Veins)

display.description: Wowhead's level-30 Warlock: Affliction and Demonology drain-tank with the Succubus (Corruption and Agony, no Immolate, then Drain Life for the rest of the fight, Life Tap when mana is low), Demonology keeps Demonic Brand up and Agonies only big targets, Destruction puts Agony, Corruption and Immolate on every mob, Conflagrates just before Immolate ends, saves Shadowburn for the killing blow and wands with the Voidwalker. Amplify Curse on every cooldown; Curse of the Elements and Bane of Doom only on elites and bosses; no pack section. Wowhead's guides stop at level 30. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warlock: all trees (Wowhead)

display.description: Melee Arms and Fury from level 1 to 60, and the default for any warrior outside Defensive Stance. Forever rage is scarce, so it pools: Charge to pull, Victory Rush when hurt, Intercept, Execute only on elites, bosses or in a group (solo on a normal mob it lets white hits finish), Whirlwind or Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and Slam on packs, Spearing Strike on Giants and Dragonkin, Rend until Bloodthirst, Overpower, Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind with rage to spare, Slam while standing, two Sunder Armors (five on elites). Reminders: Battle Shout, Bloodrage, the interrupt, Heroic Strike from 80 rage, Cleave from 60, Sweeping Strikes, Death Wish and Berserker Rage; Recklessness and Retaliation are listed but off. Left to you: stance dancing, Hamstring and consumables. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warrior: Arms and Fury (Icy Veins)

display.description: Warcraft Tavern's always-spend list for groups and raids: five Sunder Armors first, Execute above everything below 20%, Overpower, Rend until Bloodthirst, Mortal Strike, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind, Spearing Strike on cooldown, Slam once Improved Slam is taken and Hamstring with spare rage; Heroic Strike or Cleave from 60 rage, Recklessness on cooldown with Death Wish beside it. Choose it instead of the Icy Veins premade if you play in groups and do not need to save rage between pulls. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warrior: Arms and Fury, spend rage (Warcraft Tavern)

display.description: Tanking whenever you are in Defensive Stance, from level 10 to 60. Charges to pull (in Defensive Stance once you have Vanguard), Victory Rush, and on two or more enemies Thunder Clap on cooldown, Demoralizing Shout, Shield Slam, Revenge and Rend. On one target: Revenge first when rage is low, Shield Slam, Revenge, Demoralizing Shout against melee enemies, Rend, Sunder Armor (five on elites) and Thunder Clap on dangerous targets. Reminders: Battle Shout, Bloodrage, Shield Bash, Shield Block against melee hits, Heroic Strike or Cleave with spare rage and Last Stand when low; Taunt and Shield Wall are listed but off. Left to you: swapping to Battle Stance to Charge before Vanguard, taunting other enemies and picking up loose ones. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warrior: Protection (Icy Veins)

display.description: Warcraft Tavern's tanking order: Thunder Clap, Demoralizing Shout and five Sunder Armors kept on every target first, then Revenge, Rend and Shield Slam last, with Heroic Strike or Cleave from 60 rage. No Shield Block or defensive reminders. Choose it instead of the Icy Veins tank premade if you prefer to keep the debuffs up first. Listed for reference on Forever.
display.name: Forever Warrior: Protection, debuff upkeep (Warcraft Tavern)

display.description: Recommended for Blood. Highlights the spell Blizzard's Assisted Combat suggests next, the one rotation advice the game still lets an addon read in Midnight combat; it waits while you cast or channel. Alongside it, reminders for what Assisted Combat leaves to you: Vampiric Blood and Raise Dead in combat, Mind Freeze on an interruptible cast, Icebound Fortitude below 35% health, and your racial cooldown. Enemy casts and your health are hidden in combat, so those two light only where the game shows them. Active mitigation timing, Anti-Magic Shell, taunts and trinkets stay with you.
display.name: Death Knight: Blood (Retail, Blizzard Assisted)

display.description: Reference only, off by default: the guides' Blood priority. In Midnight combat your buffs, the target's debuffs, runic power and health are hidden from addons, so this list cannot run there; read it, or clone it to experiment. Pulls with Death's Caress. Death Strike below half health or at 75 runic power; Marrowrend (Death's Caress out of melee) when Bone Shield is missing, under five charges, about to expire, or Exterminate is up; during Gift of the San'layn, Death Strike above 70 runic power, one Blood Boil, Death and Decay on Crimson Scourge and Heart Strike; Death and Decay on Crimson Scourge or four enemies; Vampiric Strike; Consumption; Blood Boil on Boiling Point, a missing Blood Plague or full charges; Heart Strike. Reminders: Raise Dead, Vampiric Blood, Reaper's Mark, Dancing Rune Weapon after Reaper's Mark, plus the Assisted premade's utility reminders.
display.name: Death Knight: Blood reference (Retail, Icy Veins and Wowhead)

display.description: Reference only, off by default: SimulationCraft's Deathbringer list, which spends runic power on Death Strike for damage. Hidden combat data keeps it from running in Midnight combat. Death Strike near the runic power cap, Death and Decay whenever it is down, Reaper's Mark, Marrowrend on Exterminate, Death's Caress for Bone Shield while runes are short (else Marrowrend), Death Strike, Blood Boil, Consumption outside Dancing Rune Weapon, Heart Strike. Reminders: Raise Dead, Dancing Rune Weapon, Vampiric Blood and the utility reminders.
display.name: Death Knight: Blood Deathbringer reference (Retail, SimulationCraft)

display.description: Recommended for Frost. Highlights the spell Blizzard's Assisted Combat suggests next, the one rotation advice the game still lets an addon read in Midnight combat; it waits while you cast or channel. Alongside it, reminders for what Assisted Combat leaves to you: Breath of Sindragosa and Raise Dead in combat, Mind Freeze on an interruptible cast, Icebound Fortitude below 35% health, and your racial cooldown. Enemy casts and your health are hidden in combat, so those two light only where the game shows them.
display.name: Death Knight: Frost (Retail, Blizzard Assisted)

display.description: Reference only, off by default: the guides' Frost priority. Killing Machine, Rime, Razorice and runic power are hidden in Midnight combat, so it cannot run there. Obliterate on two Killing Machines or one with three runes, Frost Strike into five Razorice with Shattering Blade, Howling Blast on Rime, Frost Strike before runic power caps, Obliterate on Killing Machine, Frost Strike, Obliterate; three or more enemies swap in Frostscythe and Glacial Advance; Howling Blast out of melee. Reminders: Remorseless Winter, Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa and Frostwyrm's Fury in Pillar, Reaper's Mark, Raise Dead, Empower Rune Weapon at two charges or when out of Killing Machine and runic power, plus the utility reminders.
display.name: Death Knight: Frost reference (Retail, Icy Veins and SimulationCraft)

display.description: Reference only, off by default: Wowhead's Frost order, which puts its cooldowns in the rotation. Hidden combat data keeps it from running in Midnight combat. Empower Rune Weapon at two charges, Reaper's Mark, Pillar of Frost, Breath of Sindragosa, Frostwyrm's Fury; then Obliterate on two Killing Machines or one with Exterminate, Howling Blast on Rime, Frost Strike before runic power caps, Obliterate on Killing Machine, Empower Rune Weapon for a new one, Frost Strike, Obliterate, Howling Blast. Three or more enemies swap in Frostscythe and Glacial Advance.
display.name: Death Knight: Frost reference (Retail, Wowhead)

display.description: Recommended for Unholy. Before Steady Shot it keeps your Serpent Sting up and spends mana on Aimed, Multi and Arcane Shot only while you have plenty. From level 62: Multi-Shot when ready, Steady Shot straight after each Auto Shot, Arcane Shot to fill the gap, Serpent Sting when solo. With three or more enemies fighting you, Multi-Shot whenever it is ready. Reminds you of aspects (Viper when mana runs low, Hawk again at half mana), pet care, Kill Command, major cooldowns on elites and bosses and Silencing Shot. Pet commands, Misdirection, traps, Volley, melee weaving and Feign Death stay with you.
display.name: Hunter: ranged DPS (wowsims)

display.description: Arcane, chosen when Arcane is your main talent tree. Before level 64: Arcane Missiles, with Frostbolt when mana runs low. From 64: Arcane Blast while burning (Arcane Power, Bloodlust or above 35% mana), otherwise three Arcane Blast stacks and Frostbolt until they are about to drop. Arcane Explosion and Cone of Cold for three or more enemies. Reminders include Arcane Power, Presence of Mind, mana gem and Evocation.
display.name: Mage: Arcane

display.description: Fire after Icy Veins, chosen when Fire is your main talent tree. Pyroblast opens a pull once learned, Improved Scorch keeps five Fire Vulnerability stacks, Fireball fills, Fire Blast is for moving; Blast Wave, Dragon's Breath and Flamestrike for three or more enemies. Reminders: Molten, Mage or Ice Armor, Combustion below 20% target health, mana gem, Evocation and the shared Mage utilities.
display.name: Mage: Fire (Icy Veins)

display.description: Fire after Wowhead and wowsims. Like the Icy Veins Fire premade, but it weaves Fire Blast whenever it is ready while you stand still (more damage, more mana) and opens with Fireball instead of Pyroblast. Pick it in the rotation list to use it.
display.name: Mage: Fire (Wowhead)

display.description: Frost from level 1 to 70, and the Mage default before talents. Frostbolt (Fireball before level 4), Frost Nova when something hits you, Cone of Cold with Blizzard or Arcane Explosion when three or more enemies are engaged, Ice Lance on frozen targets and while moving, wand when out of mana. Reminders: armor, Arcane Intellect, mana gem, Evocation, Counterspell, Spellsteal, Ice Barrier, Icy Veins, Cold Snap and Water Elemental. Blink, Ice Block, kiting and target choice stay with you.
display.name: Mage: Frost

display.description: Healing for a Holy Paladin in a group, on your friendly target: Lay on Hands or Holy Shock for a dying target, Cleanse (Purify before 42), Holy Shock while moving, Holy Light for heavy damage, rank-5 Holy Light to keep Light's Grace up, Flash of Light otherwise. With a hostile target it keeps Judgement of Wisdom up. Reminders: Concentration Aura, Blessing of Wisdom, Divine Illumination and Divine Favor. A soloing Holy Paladin gets a Retribution premade instead.
display.name: Paladin: Holy (Icy Veins & Wowhead)

display.description: Wowhead's raid tank healing: Holy Light whenever your target is missing a tenth of their health, Flash of Light only for small deficits, with the same emergencies, cleansing, Judgement and reminders as the blended Holy premade.
display.name: Paladin: Holy (Wowhead tank healing)

display.description: Icy Veins' tanking: Judgement of the Crusader when nobody keeps it up, Righteousness (Wisdom on packs), Consecration as the main threat, Judgement, Holy Shield, then Avenger's Shield and Hammer of Wrath on cooldown. Same reminders as the Wowhead variant without Avenging Wrath.
display.name: Paladin: Protection (Icy Veins)

display.description: Tanking for the Protection tree or any Paladin with Righteous Fury on. Pulls with Holy Shield, Avenger's Shield and Judgement; against a crushing target (world boss or three or more levels above you) Holy Shield comes first; then Consecration, Exorcism on Undead and Demons, Judgement, Holy Shield, Holy Wrath on undead packs, Avenger's Shield except on crushing targets. Seal of Wisdom on packs when mana is short, Righteousness otherwise. Reminders: Righteous Fury, Devotion Aura, Sanctuary (or Kings, or Wisdom), Avenging Wrath, Lay on Hands. Taunts and target swaps stay with you.
display.name: Paladin: Protection (Wowhead & wowsims)

display.description: Icy Veins' Retribution: Judgement of the Crusader once per target, Seal of Righteousness (Command only with a slow weapon, Blood or Martyr once learned), Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath and Judgement on cooldown, Consecration on two or more enemies, Exorcism on Undead and Demons, and Holy Shock for Holy levelers. Same reminders as the Wowhead variant.
display.name: Paladin: Retribution (Icy Veins)

display.description: Off by default; enable it if you twist seals (level 64+, Seal of Command and Blood or Martyr). Opens with Judgement of the Crusader, then each swing puts up Seal of Command (rank 1) early and switches to Blood or Martyr in the last 0.4 seconds, Crusader Strike between twists, judges only Blood or Martyr, Exorcism and Consecration only as fillers, and rolls Blood without twisting below 12% mana. Needs a reliable swing timer; latency is not accounted for.
display.name: Paladin: Retribution seal twisting

display.description: Melee Retribution from level 1 to 70, and the default for any Paladin no other premade fits. Opens each target with Judgement of Wisdom (low mana) or the Crusader, keeps your best seal up (Blood or Martyr, Command, then Righteousness), Crusader Strike, judges only Righteousness, Blood or Martyr (or Command on a stunned target), Exorcism on Undead and Demons, Consecration for three or more enemies with mana to spare. Hammer of Wrath is left to you (Wowhead uses it only on fleeing targets). Reminders: Sanctity, Retribution or Devotion Aura, a Blessing on yourself, a heal after the fight, Avenging Wrath. Seal twisting is a separate premade.
display.name: Paladin: Retribution (Wowhead & wowsims)

display.description: Damage from level 1 to 70, used whenever the healer premade does not apply. Smite and wand early, then Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Flay, Shadowform, Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Death as you learn them; DoTs before Mind Blast; a dying target is wanded when solo. Holy and Discipline questers get Holy Fire and Smite. Reminders: Inner Fire, Fortitude, racial buffs, Inner Focus, Shadowfiend. Shields, healing and Mind Flay clipping stay with you.
display.name: Priest: damage (Icy Veins)

display.description: Damage after Wowhead's guides: Mind Blast opens and goes before DoT refreshes, Vampiric Embrace only when your health drops, and a dying target gets spells instead of the wand. Otherwise the same as the Icy Veins damage premade. Pick it in the rotation list to use it.
display.name: Priest: damage (Wowhead)

display.description: Healing after Icy Veins' order: Shield, dispels, Binding Heal, Renew, Flash Heal, Greater Heal (any rank), group heals, and Prayer of Mending last. You choose whom to heal. Pick it in the rotation list to use it.
display.name: Priest: healer (Icy Veins)

display.description: Healing in a group when Holy or Discipline is your main talent tree. It advises on the friendly unit you target; you choose whom to heal. Prayer of Mending before pulls and whenever ready, Renew, Power Word: Shield in emergencies, dispels, Circle of Healing or Prayer of Healing for group damage, Binding, Flash and Greater Heal, and Greater Heal rank 1 as a cheap top-up. With an enemy targeted it offers light damage.
display.name: Priest: healer (Wowhead)

display.description: Levels 1–70, every spec, following Wowhead. Same stealth openers, builders and reminders as the wowsims version, but Slice and Dice starts from one combo point and every five-point finisher is Eviscerate: no Rupture. Expose Armor, Kidney Shot, Feint, Vanish and positioning stay with you.
display.name: Rogue: melee DPS (Wowhead)

display.description: Levels 1–70, every spec. From stealth: Premeditation, then Cheap Shot solo or Garrote in a group, otherwise Ambush. In combat: Riposte, Slice and Dice from two combo points (renewed in its last two seconds), Eviscerate on a target about to die, and at five points Rupture when it will last (not while Blade Flurry cleaves), otherwise Eviscerate. Builds with Mutilate or Backstab when the target is not attacking you, otherwise Hemorrhage or Sinister Strike. Reminds you of missing poisons, Kick, Blade Flurry and Adrenaline Rush, Cold Blood and Evasion. Expose Armor, Kidney Shot, Feint, Vanish and positioning stay with you.
display.name: Rogue: melee DPS (wowsims)

display.description: Caster Elemental for the Elemental talent tree. Lightning Bolt is the filler; Chain Lightning goes out with Elemental Mastery, on Clearcasting while you have 40% mana, or freely above 80%; Flame Shock only while moving; Earth Shock interrupts; Fire Nova, Chain Lightning and Magma for packs. Before Chain Lightning a target in melee is left to auto-attack to save mana. Reminders: Water or Lightning Shield, a weapon imbue, Totem of Wrath (or Searing on long fights), Wrath of Air, Mana Spring, Totemic Call after the fight, Elemental Mastery and Bloodlust/Heroism.
display.name: Shaman: Elemental (Icy Veins & wowsims)

display.description: NextActionTBC's Elemental: keeps Flame Shock on the target, Chain Lightning only against two or more enemies while above 30% mana, Lightning Bolt otherwise. Reminds you of Lightning Shield, a weapon imbue, Elemental Mastery and Bloodlust/Heroism; totems stay manual.
display.name: Shaman: Elemental (NextActionTBC)

display.description: Wowhead's Elemental: at 70 Chain Lightning on cooldown with Lightning Bolts in between (while leveling only with Elemental Mastery or Clearcasting), Flame Shock only while moving, Earth Shock to finish a target that would die before a cast lands. Same totem, shield and cooldown reminders as the Icy Veins variant.
display.name: Shaman: Elemental (Wowhead)

display.description: Melee Enhancement from level 1 to 70, and the default for any Shaman no other premade fits. Pulls with Lightning Bolt from range, interrupts with Earth Shock, drops Fire Nova and Magma Totems on three or more nearby enemies, then Stormstrike, Earth Shock while Stormstrike's debuff is up, Flame Shock on a target that will live, Earth Shock on cooldown, and Lightning Bolt while the target is out of reach. Separate reminders: weapon imbues, Water or Lightning Shield, Strength of Earth, Windfury (group) or Grace of Air (solo), Searing on long fights, water totems, Shamanistic Rage, Bloodlust/Heroism on bosses, Stoneclaw and Earth Elemental when solo. Fire Elemental is an optional step that starts off. Totem placement, Ghost Wolf and healing stay with you.
display.name: Shaman: Enhancement (Icy Veins)

display.description: The level-70 raid model: Stormstrike, a Fire Nova Totem weave, Flame Shock whenever it has fallen off, and Earth Shock as the main shock, with Lightning Bolt only out of reach. Reminders twist Windfury and Grace of Air Totems, keep Searing down, use Shamanistic Rage when mana runs low, and share the Icy Veins variant's imbue, shield and totem upkeep. Choose it instead of the Icy Veins variant if you twist totems.
display.name: Shaman: Enhancement (Wowhead & wowsims)

display.description: Healing for the Restoration talent tree, on your friendly target (or yourself with no target): Nature's Swiftness and Healing Wave or Lesser Healing Wave in emergencies, Cure Poison and Cure Disease, Earth Shield on your focus, Chain Heal when three nearby allies are hurt, Healing Wave otherwise. With a hostile target it switches to Flame Shock and Lightning Bolt for soloing. Reminders: Water Shield, Earth Shield on your focus (set the tank as focus), Mana Tide, Mana Spring and Strength of Earth in a group, Bloodlust/Heroism. Choosing whom to heal and which rank stays with you.
display.name: Shaman: Restoration

display.description: Every talent tree from level 1 to 70. Curse, then Unstable Affliction, Immolate, Corruption and Siphon Life as learned, Shadow Bolt or Incinerate; Nightfall and Backlash procs first; Seed, Hellfire and Shadowfury for three or more enemies. Solo it drains when hurt, Life Taps, wands, and uses Drain Soul or a finisher on a dying target. Reminders: Fel Armor, Demon Armor or Demon Skin, your demon, sacrifice, Soul Link, Amplify Curse and Soulshatter. Fears and other curses stay with you.
display.name: Warlock: all trees (Icy Veins)

display.description: Warlock after Wowhead's guides. Solo it drain-tanks: Drain Life is the filler once your DoTs are up and Immolate and Siphon Life are kept for elite mobs. In a group Immolate always goes on, after Corruption and Siphon Life. Otherwise the same as the Icy Veins Warlock premade. Pick it in the rotation list to use it.
display.name: Warlock: drain-tank (Wowhead)

display.description: Levels 1–70, Arms or Fury, following Icy Veins. Same pull, reminders and leveling steps as the wowsims version, but with Mortal Strike Execute comes first, with Bloodthirst Execute comes right after it, Whirlwind follows without holding rage, and Hamstring only near full rage. Slam timing, stance dancing and Berserker Rage stay with you.
display.name: Warrior: melee DPS (Icy Veins)

display.description: Levels 1–70, Arms or Fury. Charges to pull, then Victory Rush, Intercept, Rampage, and Whirlwind when two or more enemies fight you (Thunder Clap before it is learned). With Bloodthirst or Mortal Strike: that strike, Whirlwind with rage to spare, Execute, Overpower. Before them: Whirlwind, Execute, Overpower, Rend. Spare rage goes to Devastate or Sunder Armor, then Hamstring. Reminds you of Battle Shout, Bloodrage, Heroic Strike or Cleave as rage dumps, Sweeping Strikes, Death Wish, Recklessness and interrupts. Slam timing, stance dancing and Berserker Rage stay with you.
display.name: Warrior: melee DPS (wowsims)

display.description: Levels 10–70, chosen while you are in Defensive Stance, following Icy Veins. Shield Slam, Revenge, then Devastate or Sunder Armor, with Rend at the start of a fight until Shield Slam is learned. On packs: Thunder Clap, and Demoralizing Shout against elites. Shield Block is reminded whenever your target is attacking you. Taunting and other utility stay with you.
display.name: Warrior: tank (Icy Veins)

display.description: Levels 10–70, chosen while you are in Defensive Stance. Shield Slam, Revenge, Thunder Clap and Demoralizing Shout kept up on elites and bosses, then Devastate or Sunder Armor. On packs: Thunder Clap and Demoralizing Shout first. Reminds you of Shield Block against bosses and higher-level enemies, Heroic Strike or Cleave, Battle Shout, Bloodrage, Shield Bash and emergency Last Stand and Shield Wall. Taunting and other utility stay with you.
display.name: Warrior: tank (Wowhead)
